blurb: Guests can visit the tasting room to sample wines, enjoy meals from the kitchen, and relax indoors or in the garden. The winery hosts live music every weekend and offers event spaces for weddings, showers, corporate events, and parties. Visitors may walk around the 43-acre property but tours of the winemaking area are not offered.
extraNote: Events limited to 60 guests during open hours and 100 guests outside regular hours
